# Vercel: cancel a deployment

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To cancel a Vercel deployment, call the Cancel Deployment endpoint using SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for exact endpoint path, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for required authentication headers, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for request body shape, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for success status code. Agents need the deployment ID and must handle SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for error responses when the deployment is already completed.

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-cancel-deployment --json
